text:
sylvie: Kicking off the "Catalyst Relay" microexperiment — small PLG bundle: 85 promo tokens + 5 compact relay templates + 18-min live workshop. Hypothesis: bundling templates + workshop lifts day7 retention by ~8%. Need routing, capacity, and 2 messaging angles. :sparkles:

omar: Love it. Suggest 50/50 split: tokens-only vs bundle. Keeps analysis straightforward.

kait: Wed 12pm PT for the workshop works for our audience. I'll draft landing + 3 subject lines + short CTA strings.

benji: Routing pseudo (minimal):
```
segment: new_users_0-7d
trigger: first_successful_call
actions:
  - grant_tokens: 85
  - attach_promptpack: relay-starters-v1
  - schedule_workshop_invite: +24h
  - tag_event: experiment:catalyst_relay_q2
metrics: calls_48h, template_use_ratio, day7_retention
```
We'll include experiment tag so analytics can filter.

ops-bot: Reserving capacity for day-of surge. Recommend reserve for 220 concurrent viewers; fallback recording embed if >300. Autoscale template applied. :gear:

claire: Measurement plan: primary = day7 retention lift; secondary = promptpack reuse (3+ uses) and workshop watch-rate. Want a Console dashboard called "catalyst_relay_pilot" with experiment filters.

growth-bot: Baseline pulled. cohort_day7_avg=17.4%, avg_tokens_week1=2.35k, est_unit_cost_per_activation=$5.85. CSV uploaded to #marketing-assets/catalyst_relay_baseline.csv.

sylvie: Messaging axes: A) "Ship an AI flow in minutes" (use-case) B) "Join a live workshop + get ready templates" (value). Keep hero copy <8 words. We'll A/B subject lines & CTA.

omar: CS follow-up: 2-email sequence for workshop attendees with 3 copyable templates and a short how-to micro-guide. Also an in-product nudge 48h post-workshop to prompt reuse.

benji: Analytics: please tag events with experiment and cohort_id. Also include token burn and estimated cost per retained user so we can evaluate ROI.

claire: Can someone create the dashboard? Include day7 retention by arm, avg tokens/week, prompt reuse %, and cost-per-retained-user calc.

benji: I'll spin up the experiment view in Console tomorrow AM and hook the event tags.

ops-bot: Confirmed reserve & autoscale. Will post infra plan in #eng-infra.

growth-bot: I'll refresh baseline after seed release and attach live CSVs.

sylvie: Action items:
- @kait: landing + 3 subject lines + 2 hero CTAs (EOD)
- @benji: implement routing & event tagging + dashboard request (tomorrow AM)
- @ops-bot: infra reservation + runbook (today)
- @omar: cohort split & seed plan (tomorrow AM)
- @claire: CS drip outline (tomorrow)
- @growth-bot: baseline CSV + refresh when run starts

sylvie: Quick question: token amount 85 okay? If anyone wants to propose a test split (e.g., 50 vs 85) say now but prefer uniform for clarity.

omar: 85 fine. Keep it uniform for first pass.

sylvie: Great. I'll compile a 1-pager for execs once the dashboard is live. Reconvene 24h after launch for an early signal check. :white_check_mark:
